== frame nested_negation cursor=23,20
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-1
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ ! mv absent-source negated-move
|<SHELL>: mv: absent-source: No such file or directory (os error 2)
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ ! mv negated-copy negated-move-success
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-1
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ export NATIVE_FS_COMMAND=cp
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ ! command command $NATIVE_FS_COMMAND negated-move-success ne
|sted-negated-copy > nested-negated-redirection
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-1
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@1 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@1 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@4 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@4 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 !
@7 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@7 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@10 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@10 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 !
@12 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@12 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@15 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@15 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 export
@17 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@17 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 !
@20 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@20 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo

== frame alias_negation cursor=23,20
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ ! mv negated-copy negated-move-success
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-1
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ export NATIVE_FS_COMMAND=cp
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ ! command command $NATIVE_FS_COMMAND negated-move-success ne
|sted-negated-copy > nested-negated-redirection
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-1
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ alias negated-copy-command cp
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ ! cp source alias-negated-copy
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-1
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $

|absent

|negated copy bytes
